Thereafter, on. the same day i.e. on 30-11-2006 in the evening at about 22-15 hours another first information report in respect of the same occurrence was lodged by one Md Nurul Islam, Court Officer, Bangladesh Supreme Court wherein also no person was named as accused. In the said first information report, the informant alleged that while hearing of some writ petitions were being held in Court No.12, the Hon'ble Chief Justice stayed their hearing. As a result, some of the Advocates of the writ petitioners started using abusive language and they along with some Advocates' clerks rushed to the Court room of the Hon'ble Chief Justice and started ransacking and damaging the doors, window panes and other furniture therein. Further, they threw down some of the flower pots in the balcony of the Chief Justice's office and pulled down the national flag. The same was recorded at Shahbagh PS Case No.29 dated 30-11-2006 under sections 143/149/186/448/427/500 of the Penal Code. 

 6. The learned Magistrate instead of taking cognizance directed the Officer-in-charge of the Police station to treat it as an first information report if upon investigation found prima facie case in the allegation (Annexure-A & B). Further six days after the aforesaid occurrence one Md Rafiqul Islam, Court Keeper of the High Court Division filed another first information report on 5-12-2006 being Shahbagh PS Case No.4 dated 5-12-2006 under section 143/149/186/448/427/124A of the Penal Code in respect of the self same occurrence naming petitioner Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 12 as accused along with 200 others unnamed alleging that the said occurrence of 30-11-2006 was caused by them. 

 10. In the case in hand it is very much clear that on the same self occurrence an first information report was lodged on 30-11-2006 at 5-25 PM by one Mr Md Abdul Kuddus, Administrative Officer of Attorney-General's Office with Shahbagh Police Station, DMP, Dhaka alleging 'that one 30-11-2006 at about 2-45 PM some unruly lawyers of the Supreme Court along with outsiders general people gheraod the Attorney-General's office and attacked the same and they damaged some glass of the windows and also damaged the files of the said office and some of the cars which were at parking in front of Attorney-General's office were damaged. But no names of the accused were mentioned in the aforesaid first information report. On the same day at about 22-15 hours another first information report in respect of the same occurrence was lodged by Md Nurul Islam, Court Officer, Bangladesh Supreme Court over the self same occurrence without mentioning the names of any accused persons. Further one Md Rafiqul Islam, Court Keeper of the High Court Division filed another first information report on 5-12-2006 being Shahbagh PS Case No.4 dated 5-12-2006 under sections 143/149/186/448/427/ 124A of the Penal Code in respect of the self same occurrence naming petitioner Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 12 as accused along with 200 other unknown accused persons alleging that on the date of occurrence the alleged damaged caused by them. One Barrister Omar Sadat a Junior Advocate of this Court being complainant filed a petition of com- plaint before the learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka against Barrister Rokan Uddin Mahmud, Advocate Sheikh Awsafur Rahman, Advocate Subrota Chowdhury, Advocate Enayetur Rahim and 50/60 unknown outsider mastans alleging that on 30-11-2006 at 2-15 PM to 3-30 PM the aforesaid accused persons being anti-state elements committed mischief by damaging the furniture of the Chamber of the learned Chief Justice and some of the accused persons set fire in a car and also pulled down the National Flag and brought some other allegation in respect of the self same occurrence of the aforesaid police cases. 

 13. Subject matter of the case being lodged by a Court Keeper Rafiqul Islam being Shahbagh PS Case No.4 dated 5-12-2006 under section 143/149/186/448/427/124A of the Penal Code are almost same with the instant case lodged by Barrister Omar Sadat. Ultimately the case initiated by Barrister Omar Sadat was ended in charge sheet, being charge-sheet No.44 dated 21-2-2006 under section 143/447/448/427/435/506/114 of the Penal Code against 13 accused persons including Dr Kamal Hossain, Advocate Sharwardi, Advocate Syed Mahbub Mamun, Advocate Habibur Rahman, Advocate Khairul Alam Pipul, Barrister Tania Amir and others, whose names were not in the first information report and no specific allegation was made against them. 

 20. The learned Counsel further submits that as per section 154 of the Code of Criminal Procedure the first information report means the information received by the police officers of an offence which is first in point of time and all other subsequent information falls under the purview of statement of witness recorded under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the second information can- not be treated as first information report.
